description:
Total Value Locked for a single DeFi protocol such as Aave, Uniswap or Curve. Returns USD TVL and a per-chain breakdown. Use it when the user asks how much capital is locked in a specific protocol.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

protocol_name.description: Protocol slug or display name, e.g. aave or uniswap.

name: get_protocol_tvl
